text: 海关总署广东分署发布最新数据，今年前10月广东外贸进出口9.8万亿元，已超过去年全年规模，比去年同期增长25.7%。其中，出口5.73万亿元，增长15.1%；进口4.07万亿元，增长44.6%。前10个月，广东外贸规模占全国比重达21.9%，较去年同期提升1个百分点。据了解，继今年6月历史首次突破万亿元大关后，广东进出口月度规模已连续5个月超万亿元。
text_en: The Guangdong Sub-Administration of the General Administration of Customs released the latest data: in the first 10 months of this year, Guangdong's foreign trade imports and exports totaled RMB 9.8 trillion, already exceeding the full-year scale of last year and up 25.7% year on year. Of this, exports were RMB 5.73 trillion, up 15.1%; imports were RMB 4.07 trillion, up 44.6%. In the first 10 months, Guangdong's foreign trade accounted for 21.9% of the national total, up 1 percentage point from the same period last year. It is understood that after historically exceeding the RMB 1 trillion mark for the first time in June this year, Guangdong's monthly imports and exports have remained above RMB 1 trillion for five consecutive months.
